title: Man who died trying to save two people in dangerous sea was ‘true selfless hero’
summary: Family of Mark Ratcliffe, 67, share tribute to ‘loving husband, father, son’ who died at Withernsea, East Yorkshire, on Friday A 67-year-old man who died trying to save two people in difficulty in the sea has been described as “a true selfless hero with a heart of gold”. The family of Mark Ratcliffe named him as the man who was pulled unconscious from the sea at Withernsea, East Yorkshire, on Friday afternoon. Police said he died at the scene. Continue reading...

title: U.S. Oil ‘Quarantine’ of Venezuela Will Remain, and Troops Could Land, Rubio Says
summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the Trump administration would work with Venezuela’s acting leader, Delcy Rodríguez, a Maduro ally, to get foreign investment into the oil industry.
